gate.disclosure: Conditional simulation evidence. This gate cannot establish real PayPal profit or authorize native payments.

proposal.rationale: The simulation data strongly supports retaining the `legacy_weekly` policy, which yields the highest mean ongoing profit (152.45) and durable post-campaign profit (202.40), while also maximizing merchant contribution (3011.35) and volume. The fitted model predicts ranking based on affinity and popularity, but it does not predict causal profit, nor does it control for true relationship states, unmet needs, outside spending, or future returns. We will monitor actual return rates, merchant contribution, and durable profit to ensure the legacy policy continues to perform as expected in the live market.

review.rationale: The legacy_weekly policy is selected as it demonstrates the highest merchant value (mean 3011.35) and durable follow-up (mean 202.40) among all tested policies. It consistently outperforms others in volume and share with a 100% win rate in these categories. While it has a slightly lower acquisition rate than personalized or portfolio, its overall financial impact is superior. We must monitor the reactivation rate, which is negative, and ensure the 3-seed development limits and new-model assumptions hold in production. Note that these are synthetic development outcomes, not real PayPal profit, and the same numerical program without an LLM will have the same commerce behavior at lower inference cost.
